The '''Carida system''',<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> also known as the '''Caridan system''',<ref name="Wizards" /> was home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Carida Incident|conference]] was held in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], at the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|''Valor'' space station]].<ref name="PONR" /> In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the system was destroyed after [[Kyp Durron]] launched a [[resonance torpedo]] at the system's [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Caridan (star)|Caridan]], from the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] known as the [[Sun Crusher]]. [[Nova Station]] was later built there as a waystation on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. By [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the system was beginning to be known as the '''Carida Nebula'''.
